scope: Exact failed mixed-crowd unit starts/goals tested individually with zero neighbors; original IDs, coordinates, kinds and lanes preserved
limitations: Only failed crowd units selected, not all 42 units.
10 CPU seconds per unit and 90 simulated seconds for both stages combined. CPU exceeded is unconfirmed, not evidence of disconnected topology.
Original gate polyline is a read-only geometric diagnostic, not a modified control order or actual movement acceptance.
Planner deadline depends on offline CPU; this is not a native frame benchmark.
Whole-frame raw Path.clear checks endpoint chord, which can be stricter than collision slide substeps.
